3 · Workbook p.24, Ex.3

Complete the film descriptions. Use who, which/that, whose, where. Use Ø if no pronoun is needed.

2The story takes place in a village ___ nobody tells the truth.
3She meets a musician ___ songs have made him famous.
4The camera ___ he finds changes his life.
5The woman ___ helps him is actually a detective.
6The final scene is set in the hotel ___ they first met.
7It is one of the best films ___ I have seen this year.
8The ending ___ surprised me was completely unexpected.

6 · Listening · SB p.33, Ex.9

Roadmap audio 4.8
1What product are Marie and Charlie talking about?
2How many brands do they mention?
3Listen again and make notes about each brand.
4Which brand does Charlie recommend, and why?
5Whose advice do you usually trust before buying an expensive product? Why?
Expected content
Notes should compare all three options: one is not a good buy and has poor customer service; one is high quality with excellent customer service but expensive; one is reliable, easy to use, environmentally friendly, economical and good value. The recommended option is much cheaper than the high-quality expensive one.
